ItemID: 1; Title: Okebond Super Glue Clear Strong Repair (Blue OB-4700+1pcs); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for small repairs alongside my adhesive tape and epoxy supplies, though bond performance would matter.
ItemID: 2; Title: DCP Donseal PU440 Concrete Sealant - Paintable Concrete Expansion Joint Filler - Non-sag Polyurethane Caulk for Joints & Walls - Grey Concrete Sealer 10.1 fl. oz Cartridge; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a concrete joint or wall sealing project in mind.
ItemID: 3; Title: Bitomic 1ML Borosilicate Glass Syringe with Golden Metal Plunger | 10 Pack | Anti-Leak Luer Lock Syringe without Needle | Accurate Measuring Syringe for Liquid, Glue, Oil w/ Borosilicate Glass Tube; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Precision dispensing has some appeal, but ten small glass syringes feel too specialized for my current repair work.
ItemID: 4; Title: VIGRUE 1/4 x 1" to 3" Hex Lag Bolts, 108PCS 1/4 Hex Lag Screws Wood Screws Washers Assortment kit 18-8(304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These add larger wood fastening options to the machine screws and rivet hardware I already use.
ItemID: 5; Title: 1290 PCS 24 Size Rubber O Ring Assortment Kit, O Ring Set with Pick & Hook Kit, Universal Rubber Pressure Washer O Ring Kit for Hose, Faucet, Automotive, Air and Gas Sealing Repair; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A range of replacement seals would be handy for repair jobs, and the picks would help remove old rings.
ItemID: 6; Title: Akfix 610 Construction Adhesive Outdoor - Clear Polyurethane Wood Sealant for Floor, Ceramic, Tile, Concrete, Rubber, Metal, Marble, Waterproof Bathroom Adhesive | 3 Pack, 10.48 Oz.; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Three cartridges are more than I would choose without a specific larger bonding project.
ItemID: 7; Title: luxvoko 4Pcs Pegboard Wall Organizer Panels, Wall Control PegBoard Combination Kit 10''x10''ABS Drillable Peg Boards for Wall Display or Storage in Craft Room Garage Kitchen Office Study Room; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Organizing my growing tool collection appeals to me, but I would check panel capacity and mounting needs before choosing these.
ItemID: 8; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These would protect wiring through drilled holes in fabrication projects; I would verify the hole and panel fit.
ItemID: 9; Title: 4-40 and 6-32 Machine Screws, Nuts and Washer 280 pcs Pan Head Screws #4-40#6-32 - Screws Nuts and Washers Set - Full Thread Small Screws with Storage Box; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small imperial fasteners complement my metric assortments and would be useful for equipment repairs.
ItemID: 10; Title: #14 x 3/4" Flat Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Wood Screws, 30 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Stainless countersunk screws fit my DIY interests, but I would wait until a project calls for this particular diameter and length.
